definitions.short: to rend , i.e. open (especially the mouth)
definitions.full: H6475. patsah [ מָּצָה ] verb part, open (Arabic I, II. separate, remove ; Aramaic מְּצָא especially set free , Pa`el set free ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular מָּֽצְתָה Gen 4:11 +, 2 masculine singular מָּצִיתָ Judg 11:36 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִפְצֶה Job 35:16 ; Imperative masculine singular מְּצֶה Ezek 2:8 , suffix פְצֵנִי Psa 144:7 ; 144:11 ; Participle מֹּצֶה Isa 10:14 , ׳מּוֺ Psa 144:10 ; — 1 open mouth: a. to swallow, figurative of ground , הָאֲדָמָה Gen 4:11 , (J), Num 16:30 (JE), הָאָרֶץ Deut 11:6 ; of enemies, + עַל person Lam 2:16 ; 3:46 ; Psa 22:14 ; literal Ezek 2:8 . b. to speak Judg 11:35-36 , (utter a vow, + ׳אֶליֿ ); Job 35:16 ; hence = utter , שְׁפָתַי מָּצוּ אֲשֶׁר Psa 66:14 ; of bird chirping פֶה מֹּצֶה Isa 10:14 (in figurative). 2 snatch away, set free (Aramaic loan-word), only Psalm 144, + הִצִּיל with מִן Isa 10:7 ; 10:11 ; ׳פ with מִן 10:10 .
